_help: Each scenario is one user message sent to the configured provider against the current data. expect keys: tools_any (at least one of these was called; erp_ask_user counts when a form came back), tools_none (none of these), no_tools (nothing was called), card (true/false), card_tool, args (payload values of the first card; a value starting with ~ means 'contains'), form (true/false), asks (a form or a question mark in the answer), status, answer_any (the answer holds at least one of these). Placeholders: {in_20_days}, {next_month}.
